meta.title: Website concept
meta.description: A home page at two widths, for a website concept (never a post): Desktop, 1440 wide, and Phone, 390 wide, beside it. It is the editorial standard: a light display serif set large and tight (font.heading, weight 400, never bold), a quiet light sans for words (font.body, 300), small mono labels (font.label), neutral grounds (paper, stone, night) and the one brand colour only on the short rules, the italic word and links. Sections, top to bottom: Hero (a full-bleed photo with a scrim, the Nav over it, the words bottom left), Intro (an eyebrow and a split, photo 4:5 beside the words), Band (a full-bleed photo with words bottom left), Services (an index list: numbered rows between hairlines), Facts (numbers with mono labels), Contact (a centred closing invitation with the Form) and Footer (dark, a big wordmark, four columns). Every section is a frame whose children flow top to bottom, so it grows with its words and the page grows with its sections. This is a starting point, not the look: restyle, reorder, delete, duplicate or redraw sections until the concept has a character of its own, and change both frames together so Phone is the same site laid out for a phone (splits stack with the photo first). The rectangles named Photo stand for pictures: fill them with the person's photos or art (import_image, fit crop; pixel art with scale); with no photos, delete them and their scrims and let the words carry the page. A heading line in two texts sets its second word in italic in the brand colour: keep at most one per heading. Form stands for a form: Cobra's contact or waitlist form, or one of the site's own with the fields the business needs, drawn in the concept's style (hairline fields, one button). Every word is an example: use the person's.

children.name: HeroLede
children.content: Calm, careful grooming by people who know dogs. One dog at a time, never a queue.

children.name: IntroBody
children.content: We groom one dog at a time in a calm, sunny room off Harbour Street. No cages, no rush, and no dryers roaring in the next room: just a bath, a cut and a lot of praise.

children.name: BandBody
children.content: Short first visits, lots of breaks and a treat at every step, so grooming is never something to fear.

children.name: Item1Body
children.content: Bath, cut, nails and ears, the way your dog likes it.

children.name: Item2Body
children.content: A wash, a brush out and a trim between full grooms.

children.name: Item3Body
children.content: Short, gentle first visits for dogs under six months.

children.name: Item4Body
children.content: A ten minute visit, no booking needed on weekdays.

children.name: ContactBody
children.content: Leave your name and email and we will write back within a day with a time that suits.

children.name: HoursLines
children.content:
Tue to Sat · 9 to 5
Sun and Mon · closed
